grh_2941b14d9dff2aa35bec.title: Caged
paragraphs: Young widow Marie Allen enters womenâ€™s prison for taking part in a forty-dollar robbery committed with her late husband and discovers she is pregnant soon after arrival. Frightened and determined to serve her time cleanly, she is caught between humane superintendent Ruth Benton and brutal matron Evelyn Harper, whose corruption and cruelty help turn prison into a school for crime. Marie gives birth behind bars, but when neither her mother nor the institution can legally keep the baby for her until parole, the child is placed for adoption. A friend dies after being denied release, Harperâ€™s abuse hardens Marie further, and professional criminals begin offering her an easier path outside. By the time parole finally comes, Marie rejects an honest job arranged for her and chooses a criminal connection instead, trading her wedding ring and innocence for the promise of real diamonds and fast money. Benton orders her file kept active, certain the system that helped harden Marie will soon bring her back.

Other credited names include Bill Cairn as director, Jack Rubin as radio adaptor, and Jimmy Wallington as announcer.

grh_290cab48c8205f8ebae8.title: Spring In The Air
paragraphs: With spring putting romance in the air, Judy Price confides to Dr. Christian that she is secretly engaged to young physician Ralph Gardner. Ralph is building his career with financial help from a disapproving uncle and has insisted that nobody know about the engagement until he is established. When he learns Judy has told Christian, he becomes angry, tells her to pretend they have broken up and stops seeing her openly. Judy believes he is working nights as hard as she is so they can marry sooner. Christian finally persuades the exhausted Judy to go out for dinner, where they unexpectedly find Ralph dancing with wealthy Laura Payson. Confronted outside, Ralph makes his choice plain: he intends to marry Laura and resents Judy questioning him. Judy is devastated, but Christian helps her see that losing a man willing to trade loyalty for money and position is not the end of love. He reminds her that, like spring itself, love can come around again.

The surviving recording runs about 29 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.8830590ae040a6fd|Vaseline (World's Fair contest)]].

grh_294bef67e7cc8dd77ce6.title: All My Sons
paragraphs: Manufacturer Joe Keller has built his life around providing for his family, but his son Chris discovers that Joe knowingly allowed defective aircraft cylinders to be shipped during the war and let partner Herbert Deever take the blame. Twenty-one pilots died, and Joe insists he did it to protect the business for his sons. A letter from missing son Larry reveals that Larry learned of his father's crime and deliberately went to his death because he could not live with the shame. Joe finally understands that the dead airmen were 'all my sons' too. Moments later a gunshot from the house tells Chris that his father has killed himself.

grh_294eaeb7c5f05b724e3a.title: One Way Passage
paragraphs: Escaped convict Dan Hardesty, being returned to San Quentin to face execution, meets terminally ill Joan Ames aboard a Pacific liner. Neither initially reveals the death sentence hanging over them, and they fall in love while trying to crowd a lifetime of happiness into the voyage and a day ashore in Honolulu. At San Francisco Joan discovers Dan is the prisoner, runs after him for one final goodbye and dies as he is taken toward the death house. On New Year's Eve in Acapulco, their doctor watches two cocktail glasses mysteriously break with their stems crossed in the X Dan and Joan used to mark their happiest moments, suggesting they have found each other after death.

grh_2982ba9eba130a71ea0b.title: The Football Fix (AFRTS)
paragraphs: Pro quarterback Jerry Brady hires Rocky after fixer Addison pressures him to throw a championship game, but the case becomes a murder investigation when coach Pat Casey is killed and conflicting sightings place Brady in impossible locations. Rocky uncovers an escaped identical twin whom Jerry has secretly been hiding, a double that has scrambled the alibis and been used throughout the scheme. Addison’s betting operation collapses during the final confrontation, and the surviving players are left to answer for the fix and the killing.

grh_290af5021fc3a2b25b6d.title: Familiar Stranger
paragraphs: Graduate student Jean Myers travels to a mountain community to record supposedly untouched American folk music and believes she has discovered a gifted local singer named Obadiah Flumory. A casual autograph reveals that Obadiah is actually famous performer Davie Fields, home under his real identity to escape the loneliness of celebrity. Jean is angry at the deception but realizes she cared for the man and his music before knowing his fame, and their mutual attraction survives the revelation.
